messages.m365OAuthConnected: Microsoft 365 connected. Hosts were set to Office 365 defaults. Use Test Connection / Send Test Email to verify.
messages.m365OAuthDisconnected: Microsoft 365 disconnected from this Group Email Account.
messages.m365ConnectHelp: Connect this group mailbox with Microsoft 365. Creates an OAuth account in the background and opens Microsoft sign-in — no app password needed.
messages.m365LinkedButDisconnected: An OAuth account is linked but has no access token. Click Reconnect to authorize Microsoft again.
messages.m365SaveBeforeConnect: Save the Group Email Account first, then connect Microsoft 365.
messages.m365ProviderMissing: Microsoft 365 OAuth provider was not found. Run rebuild and configure Client ID/Secret under Administration → OAuth Providers.
messages.m365ProviderNotConfigured: Microsoft 365 OAuth provider is not configured (missing Client ID / secret). Ask an admin to set it under OAuth Providers.
messages.m365PopupBlocked: Could not open the Microsoft sign-in window. Allow popups for this site and try again.
